in_sanskrit.name: मोहन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mohan is a Sanskrit word which means 'Delight', 'Enchantment'. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'mohana' which means 'to delight', 'to enchant'. In Hindu mythology, Mohan is an epithet used to describe various deities who have the power to delight or enchant.

in_hindi.name: मोहनलाल
in_hindi.long_meaning: Mohanlal is a Hindi name which is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Mohan' (Delight, Enchantment) and 'Lal' (Beloved, Dear). The name Mohanlal means 'Beloved delight'.

in_tamil.name: மோஹனலால்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Mohanlal is a Tamil name which is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Mohan' (Delight, Enchantment) and 'Lal' (Beloved, Dear). The name Mohanlal means 'Beloved delight'. In Tamil, 'கிழந்த்த' (Kizhndh) is used to denote 'beloved' or 'dear'.

in_telugu.name: మోహన్నళ
in_telugu.long_meaning: Mohanlal is a Telugu name which is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Mohan' (Delight, Enchantment) and 'Lal' (Beloved, Dear). The name Mohanlal means 'Beloved delight'. In Telugu, 'దేశికి' (Deeshiki) is used to denote 'beloved' or 'dear'.

in_marathi.name: Mohanlal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Delight of the Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mohanlal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mohanlal is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Delight of the Gods'. This name is associated with the Hindu deity Vishnu, who is often depicted as Mohan, the enchanter or the one who delights the senses.
